## Scope and publication status

The retained Published value describes current library publication status, not engineering approval. This exercise uses instructional inputs and nominal criteria; actual compression resistance and complete lifting-system assessment remain unvalidated. The authoritative numerical common model follows independent I1.

## Assigned data

The packet provides all 23 effective inputs. Lb means horizontal a, not the historical picture's diagonal length. All baseline and exam values are retained.
